name: United States magnet plant
sentence: One plant winds and tests every magnet for the Americas and Europe, and a storm, a strike or a grid curtailment stops it with nothing to cover.

name: China plant
sentence: One plant builds every magnet and system for Asia inside a counterparty's borders, and a listing or a trade rupture strands it.

name: United States hub
sentence: One site assembles every system for two regions, so any stop there delays every install at once.

name: Superconducting wire
sentence: Every conventional magnet is wound from one mill's superconducting wire, and qualifying a second mill takes longer than the backlog covers.

name: Cold heads
sentence: One maker in Japan supplies the cold heads that keep every magnet cold, and without one a magnet cannot ship or stay cold in the field.

name: Programmable logic
sentence: The control electronics for every system use programmable logic that a foundry interruption or an entity listing can stop.

name: Technicians
sentence: The winding and cryogenic trades at the United States plant live in one town, and a strike or a retirement cliff cuts output without any supplier failing.

name: Helium cover
sentence: Helium cover at the United States plant is shorter than the time to reroute a shipment, so any interruption to power, road or port reaches the line.
